narr: A few weak disturbances tracked along the northern periphery of a strong upper ridge, triggering scattered thunderstorms. Many of the storms developed near a frontal boundary that was approaching the New York-Pennsylvania border. With heat, humidity and instability in place, some thunderstorms moved very slowly producing 1 to 2 inches of rainfall within an hour which contributed to flooding in the metropolitan areas surrounding Wilkes-Barre.
ev: Streets and roads were flooded in West Pittston. Several vehicles were stranded in flood waters.
